$comment: Small variant of eval_full — keeps every pillar from the dissertation
evaluation plan but trims each block to its single most representative
scenario / ablation / sweep, with n_seeds=2 for minimal statistical
repetition.  Sits between eval_full_smoke (n_seeds=1, every combo) and
eval_full (n_seeds=10-30, every combo): coverage is still architectural
but you pay only ~2x the smoke wallclock instead of the full ~15x.
Use this when you want a quick but still slightly-averaged read across
all pillars; promote to eval_full for publication-quality numbers.
name: eval_full_small

experiments.$comment: Pillar 1 — functional restoration quality.  Single mid-tight slack (0.45) keeps the deficit interesting without saturating.
experiments.name: functional_baseline

experiments.$comment: Pillar 2 — optimality gap.  Pairs scare with oracle on identical (grid, seed).
experiments.name: optimality_gap

experiments.$comment: Pillar 3 — variant comparison: scare vs single_level vs component_level vs oracle.  All four variants kept because the comparison IS the pillar.
experiments.name: variant_comparison

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4a — holonic / QP-gossip / priority core ablations, trimmed to baseline + the three highest-impact flags.
experiments.name: ablation_core

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4b — cross-sector / CP-layer ablations.  Keeps baseline + CP-ADMM-off + xs-coalitions-off (the two flags that carry the L2.5 mesh).
experiments.name: ablation_cross_sector

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4c — line-loading / constraint-aware path.  Baseline + monitor-off captures the headline effect.
experiments.name: ablation_line_stress

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4d — voltage support.  Two rows: with vs without Q-V droop on pv_peak.
experiments.name: ablation_voltage

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4e — thermal stress.  Baseline + heat_recovery-off on cold_day.
experiments.name: ablation_thermal

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4f — reconfiguration ranking ablation.
experiments.name: ablation_reconfig

experiments.$comment: Pillar 4g — Hebbian formation.  Warmup forced to 2 s so the flag fires inside a 10 s sim.
experiments.name: ablation_hebbian

experiments.$comment: Pillar 5a — packet-loss robustness.  Three points (0, 10, 50 %) instead of five.
experiments.name: robustness_packet_loss

experiments.$comment: Pillar 5b — latency jitter.  Three points (0, 200, 1000 ms).
experiments.name: robustness_latency

experiments.$comment: Pillar 6 — cascading.  Endpoints (1 failure, 5 failures) only.
experiments.name: cascading

experiments.$comment: Voltage-stress pillar — Q-V droop attribution on pv_peak.

experiments.$comment: Generator-class failures — all three failure_type values, all three variants.

experiments.$comment: Pillar 7 — scaling.  All three sizes kept because the scaling axis IS the pillar.
